 Shola Ogundana: «We tried to create chances to get back into the game» 
 Ukrainian Cup 
 Shola Ogundana: «We tried to create chances to get back into the game»
 27.10.2026, 22:09 
 Print 
 Share: 
 Dynamo midfielder Shola Ogundana commented on the defeat to Shakhtar in the Ukrainian Cup Round of 16 match.
 – We did everything we could to win. We will come back stronger, try to win our next matches and play at a high level.
 – From the opening minutes, the team pressed the opposition high up the pitch. Was the high press an important part of your game plan? 
 – Yes, it worked well for us, and we were happy with it. However, it does not matter now because we suffered a defeat.
 – Shakhtar opened the scoring in the final minutes of the first half. If you had not conceded that goal, could the game have followed a different course? 
 – Yes, of course. During the break, we tried to devise a plan that would help us get back into the game. But this is football: there are both victories and defeats. The most important thing now is to focus on the next match.
 – After the break Dynamo had several promising attacks. What was missing for you to finish them with a goal? 
 – I do not think anything was missing. We tried to create chances to get back into the game. I hope things will go better in the next match.
 – Emotions were running high on the pitch. How do you remain calm given the importance of the match? 
 – We have to remain professionals and stay focused on the game, following the coaching staff’s instructions.
 – Dynamo will soon face Shakhtar again in Lviv, but this time in the Ukrainian Premier League. How will this match help you prepare for the upcoming encounter? 
 – It will certainly help in terms of motivation. This defeat will motivate us to win next time.
